verified_facts.text: The Laurus is on Sentosa Island, 25 minutes from Changi Airport and 10 minutes from the CBD.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on Sentosa Island, The Laurus is 25 minutes from Changi Airport and 10 minutes from the CBD

verified_facts.text: A stay at The Laurus extends into the wider Resorts World Sentosa destination.
verified_facts.excerpt: Your stay at The Laurus is part of a larger journey, extending beyond the tranquillity of your suite into the vibrant world of Resorts World Sentosa.

verified_facts.text: Singapore Oceanarium and Universal Studios Singapore are just steps away.
verified_facts.excerpt: From unforgettable moments at Singapore Oceanarium and Universal Studios Singapore to exclusive resort happenings and family-friendly adventures, a wealth of discoveries awaits just steps away.

verified_facts.text: The interiors blend Peranakan and colonial influences with tropical motifs.
verified_facts.excerpt: the interiors blend Peranakan and colonial influences, complemented by tropical motifs

verified_facts.text: The resort draws inspiration from a well-travelled collector's home, bringing together art, objects and textures from diverse eras and cultures.
verified_facts.excerpt: the resort weaves together art, objects, and textures from diverse eras and cultures

verified_facts.text: Each suite is conceived as a private retreat within the home of a well-travelled collector.
verified_facts.excerpt: each suite unfolds as a private retreat within the home of a well‑travelled collector

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite has a ceiling mural by Singaporean artist Geraldine Toh.
verified_facts.excerpt: a ceiling mural by Singaporean artist Geraldine Toh

verified_facts.text: The Presidential Suite features an island bathtub.
verified_facts.excerpt: Presidential Suite, featuring an island bathtub

verified_facts.text: The suites feature art made in partnership with ART:DIS, which supports artists with disabilities.
verified_facts.excerpt: In partnership with ART:DIS, inclusivity and creative expression is part of the experience

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms are finished in marble and stocked with Byredo products.
verified_facts.excerpt: your beautifully finished marble bathroom, curated with Byredo products

verified_facts.text: The minibar is replenished each day with refreshments from local artisans and producers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each day, your minibar is thoughtfully replenished with a selection of refreshments by local artisans and producers.

verified_facts.text: The Laurus has a signature scent created exclusively by Maison 21G.
verified_facts.excerpt: signature scent created exclusively by Maison 21G

verified_facts.text: The Premier King Pool View suite looks out over lush greenery and the pool below.
verified_facts.excerpt: views of lush greenery and the tranquil pool below

verified_facts.text: Beds have Simmons mattresses.
verified_facts.excerpt: Simmons mattresses

verified_facts.text: The resort spa is BODHI Spa, from an Australian wellness brand.
verified_facts.excerpt: At the heart of wellness at The Laurus is BODHI Spa, Australia’s award-winning wellness brand.

verified_facts.text: BODHI Spa offers signature treatments such as the Zerobody Dry Float and the Recovery Red Light Pod.
verified_facts.excerpt: Signature offerings such as the Zerobody Dry Float and Recovery Red Light Pod

verified_facts.text: BODHI Spa has treatment rooms and private VIP suites.
verified_facts.excerpt: Within serene treatment rooms and private VIP suites

verified_facts.text: The outdoor pool sits at the heart of the resort, framed by lush greenery.
verified_facts.excerpt: At the heart of the resort, the pool offers a tranquil setting framed by lush greenery and natural light throughout the day.

verified_facts.text: The pool area includes a children's pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Children's Pool

verified_facts.text: The Pool Bar sits in a lush garden setting by the pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Pool Bar invites guests to unwind in a lush garden setting poolside.

verified_facts.text: The fitness centre overlooks tropical greenery.
verified_facts.excerpt: Overlooking tropical greenery, the space brings an added sense of openness to your workout

verified_facts.text: A Taste of Tradition is a daily, complimentary showcase of local delicacies such as Nyonya kueh in the lobby.
verified_facts.excerpt: From artisanal Nyonya kueh to pastries with flavours inspired by the region, each treat celebrates our locale’s culinary heritage. This experience is available daily and complimentary for guests.

verified_facts.text: The Cocoa Journey is a weekly chocolate and beverage pairing experience.
verified_facts.excerpt: Embark on a Cocoa Journey, a weekly chocolate and beverage pairing experience showcasing the craft of sustainably sourced chocolatiers.

verified_facts.text: The Laurus Kitchen Sessions begin with a guided walk through the Chef's Herb Garden, followed by a three-course meal in Laurus Table's private kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Laurus Kitchen Sessions begin with a guided walk through the Chef’s Herb Garden, followed by a bespoke three‑course dining experience in Laurus Table’s private kitchen.

verified_facts.text: The Collector's Trail is a guided tour of the resort exploring its art, nature and heritage-inspired design.
verified_facts.excerpt: A curated journey through The Laurus, this guided tour invites you to explore the resort as an expression of place, culture and craft.

verified_facts.text: Sentosa Golf Club is located near the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sentosa Golf Club, located near our luxury resort

verified_facts.text: Laurus Table pairs the cuisine of Italy's Amalfi Coast with Singapore's coastal bounty.
verified_facts.excerpt: Laurus Table offers a refined culinary experience that marries the elegance of Italy’s Amalfi Coast with Singapore’s coastal bounty.

verified_facts.text: Cocktails at The Collector's Bar feature herbs and botanicals from the Chef's Herb Garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cocktails and mocktails feature herbs and botanicals from the Chef’s Herb Garden
